counterfactual_missing_items: normal serum IgG4 levels do not strongly support autoimmune pancreatitis
elevated CA19-9 level is not exclusive to pancreatic cancer
decisive_items: diffuse narrowing of the main pancreatic duct
diffuse pancreatic enlargement with low T1 signal, slightly high T2 signal, and high diffusion-weighted imaging signal
response.rationale: Chronic pancreatitis is supported by the combination of abdominal pain, elevated hepatobiliary enzymes, and imaging findings of a narrowed pancreatic duct, whereas autoimmune pancreatitis is less likely due to normal serum IgG4 levels and pancreatic cancer is less likely due to the diffuse nature of the pancreatic enlargement and uptake on FDG-PET

rejected.why: elevated CA19-9 level is not exclusive to pancreatic cancer and the diffuse uptake on FDG-PET can be seen in other conditions
